payload.justification: The door is the only visible exit and is currently closed. Its availability is unknown, so attempting to open it tests whether it is unlocked and passable.
payload.expected_outcome: The door opens, enabling the go action; or the result reveals that it is locked or otherwise blocked.
payload.subgoal: Open the door to reach the exit.
plan: If opened, go through the door
If locked, inspect the door and look for a matching item
